annotations.title: Choose the type for a finished test

description: Record the type the person picks for their finished Typeza test: after answer_test returns status choose_type, the candidate that describes them best, or any type they say fits them better than their result. `type` accepts a Typeza name, slug or code. Returns the result as answer_test does, with keep_url, using the Typeza type name. For a signed-in person this replaces their current Typeza type.
